user_reported_bug: Again STUCK. /api/auth/me pending (high load time) leaves the app frozen on a blank spinner; /api/leads pending ~3 min then Server Error; too many API calls fire when clicking one menu; Data failed - API Error - No data response.
summary: Focused frontend retest of the pending auth/leads/API pile-up bug. No relevant testing skill found; auth testing playbook was used as an auth checklist. The previously failing stalled /api/auth/me case is fixed: with /auth/me intentionally left pending, the protected route left the blank spinner and showed the login screen within ~12.5s, and /auth/me fired exactly once on a single app load. Normal admin login, guest 401 login fallback, poller de-dupe/no-overlap, hidden-tab pause/resume, stalled /api/leads 60s busy-toast behavior, widgets, and real Leads list/open-lead flow all passed.

integration_issues.flow: Leads page auxiliary saved filters load
integration_issues.issue: Minor existing observation: one Leads navigation still fired /api/filters?page=leads twice under React StrictMode. The heavy /api/leads list request was correctly de-duped to exactly one request, and no user-visible freeze/error occurred.

action_items: Optional: de-dupe the auxiliary /api/filters?page=leads call under React StrictMode to remove the last minor duplicate read observed during Leads navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx now removes the StrictMode alive-gating failure mode, races /auth/me against a hard 10s timer, uses noCancel, and has no retry loop; runtime evidence confirmed stalled auth bootstrap falls back to login and requests /api/auth/me once on a single load.
TEST-ONLY MOCKED route stubs/delays were used in browser tests to simulate stalled /auth/me, delayed /calls/active, stalled /leads, and positive widget data; product APIs/integrations are not mocked.

success_rate.backend: auth API smoke passed (login 200, /auth/me 200 via curl)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use https://homeivf-crm-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin credentials worked. Key evidence: stalled /api/auth/me single-load test showed login within ~12.5s and auth_count=1; guest no-token showed single 401 then login; normal login and protected /leads reload worked; delayed /calls/active max_inflight=1; initial pollers each fired once; one Leads menu click fired /api/leads count=1; hidden-tab pause/resume and navigation poller continuation passed; stalled /api/leads produced one busy toast at ~60s; widgets rendered/interacted with TEST-ONLY MOCKED stubs; real lead 500210 opened without Data failed/API Error text.
rca_of_the_issue: Prior failure was caused by auth bootstrap using a route-aborted /auth/me request whose cancellation could be swallowed into a never-settling promise, plus StrictMode lifecycle gating/retry behavior. The new bounded Promise.race + noCancel + no alive gate + single attempt prevents the blank-spinner deadlock.
